mapper.insert: INSERT INTO risk_assessment (user_id, loan_id, credit_score, credit_level, risk_level, risk_reasons, auto_approved, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{loanId}, #{creditScore}, #{creditLevel}, #{riskLevel}, #{riskReasons}, #{autoApproved}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM risk_assessment WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
